title: Jagged Pepper Chicken Tikka Masala
description: A popular Indian-inspired dish made with tender chicken, jagged peppers and a rich, creamy sauce. Serve over basmati rice for a satisfying meal.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine ye, alica spice, garam masala, and pepper. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the blended spice mixture, chicken, and romano cheese. Mix well to coat.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken mixture and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced beg onions and cook until they are lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the jagged peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and coconut milk. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add the cooked chicken to the saucepan and toss to coat with the sauce.
Serve the chicken tikka masala over basmati rice and garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
